lines.en: Oh my gosh, Rachel, are you okay?
Okay, I was at the airport getting into a cab
when this woman, this blonde planet with a pocketbook
starts yelling at me something about how it was her cab first.
And then the next thing I know, she just starts pulling me out by my hair.
You know, and then I'm blowing my attack whistle thingy
and then three more cabs show up.
As I'm going to get into a cab, she tackles me.
And I hit my head on the curb and cut my lip on my whistle.
Everybody having fun at the party?
